in_sanskrit.name: धीमान्त
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धी: intellect, mind, understanding, wisdom, insight. मान्त: to be, exist. धीमान्त: One who has a brilliant intellect or mind.

in_telugu.meaning: ధీ: ధియే. మాన్ద: మీదేశోదేశో. ధీమాన్ద: ధియేపోదు, మీదేశోదేశో దేశి.

in_marathi.name: Dheemant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheemant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheemant is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dhi’ which means ‘intellect’ and ‘mant’ meaning ‘protection’. This name symbolizes a powerful and fearless individual, one who uses their intellect to protect and serve.
